english.title: Driver of a taxi on arrival at a Gatwick Airport authorised standing fail to offer ticket for endorsement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed, on arrival at an authorised standing on Gatwick Airport - London designated on a ticket issued to you by or on behalf of Gatwick Airport Limited, to offer the ticket for endorsement in a manner prescribed by the company to

(A)_[a constable]_
(B)_[a traffic warden in uniform]_
(C)_[Gatwick Airport Limited]_
(D)_[an airport official]_

when requested to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9(14) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
